visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a black 'Kaiju No. 8' graphic t-shirt and a black mask, stands on a sunlit balcony. He speaks excitedly to the camera and points toward the interior of the building. (2) The camera follows him as he walks through a doorway into a modern, brightly lit living room. A woman with long reddish-brown pigtails, wearing a white character-print tank top and a pink floral skirt, is sitting on a gray L-shaped couch. (3) The man sits next to her. A graphic featuring four men's headshots in colored frames appears on the screen. The man gestures toward the screen while talking to the woman. (4) A third person, wearing a white shirt, enters the frame and holds a plastic container of blueberries near a coffee table. He picks one up for a close-up shot. (5) The woman leans in to eat a blueberry. Another young man, wearing a black long-sleeve shirt, reacts with an exaggerated shock expression and jumps over the back of the couch. Speed-line graphics surround the frame. (6) The young man in the black long-sleeve shirt feeds a blueberry to the woman by hand. Pink heart graphics and a soft-focus filter are applied to the frame as the woman smiles widely at the camera.
